input.prompt: Simulate a face centered cubic lattice structure for Copper using LAMMPS with a lattice constant of 3.61 angstrom. The simulation should use metal units, define a 10x10x10 simulation box, set periodic boundary conditions to True in all directions and use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential. Run NVT simulations with timestep of 1 femtosecond using Nose-Hoover temperature thermostat at 300 K temperature with temperature damping factor of 0.1 for 10,000 steps. Then, run NPT simulations at 300 K temperature and 0 atm pressure using Nose-Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose-Hoover pressure barostat with pressure damping factor of 1.0 and temperature damping factor of 0.1 for 10,000 steps. After relaxation, run heating NPT simulations where temperature is ramped from 300 K to 1000 K at 0 atm pressure using Nose-Hoover temperature thermostat and Nose-Hoover pressure barostat with pressure damping factor of 1.0 and temperature damping factor of 0.1 for 10,000 steps. As the final output, give the density of the system in g/cm^3 units. This is a large simulation, hence multiple CPU cores are recommended.
